description: Utility functions and constants for managing MCP server statuses, health metrics, formatting, and validation within a web client project.

methods.name: getMCPStatusColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with a given MCP server status.

methods.name: getMCPStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with a given MCP server status.

methods.name: calculateOverallHealth
methods.description: Calculates an overall health score based on server health data.

methods.name: aggregateMCPSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of MCP server health and status.

methods.name: formatUptime
methods.description: Formats server uptime duration into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatResponseTime
methods.description: Formats response time in milliseconds into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatSuccessRate
methods.description: Formats a success rate as a percentage string.

methods.name: formatErrorRate
methods.description: Formats an error rate as a percentage string.

methods.name: formatMemoryUsage
methods.description: Formats memory usage in MB or GB.

methods.name: formatCpuUsage
methods.description: Formats CPU usage percentage.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a relative or detailed string based on mode.

methods.name: getHealthStatusText
methods.description: Returns a health status label based on a health score.

methods.name: getHealthStatusColor
methods.description: Returns a color code based on a health score.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Simplifies or fully displays error messages based on mode.

methods.name: calculatePerformanceMetrics
methods.description: Calculates key performance metrics from server metrics data.

methods.name: serverNeedsAttention
methods.description: Determines if a server requires attention based on its metrics.

methods.name: sortServersByPriority
methods.description: Sorts servers prioritizing errors and issues.

methods.name: filterHealthEventsByType
methods.description: Filters health events by specified type.

methods.name: getRecentHealthEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent health events.

methods.name: validateToolParameters
methods.description: Validates tool parameters against a schema.
